cohort: The study included 938 pregnant women aged 18-45 years attending prenatal care at Brazilian Unified Health System health units in the urban area of Santo Antonio de Jesus, Bahia, Brazil.
finding: A higher risk of premature birth was found among black women compared to non-black women (RR 3.22; 95%CI 1.42-7.32), and maternal age between 18 and 24 years was also associated with premature birth.
